recipes.name: Grilled Salmon with Creamy Pesto Sauce

steps.text: Preheat an outdoor drill for medium heat and lightly oil the grate.
Brush both sides salmon with oil. Cook on the preheated grill, skin-sides down, until easily flakes with a fork, 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, add cream cheese and milk to a saucepan; cook over medium heat until cream cheese completely melted and sauce well blended, stirring constantly, 2 to 3 minutes. Stir in pesto.
Top salmon with sauce and parsley to serve.

raw_recipe.headline: Grilled Salmon with Creamy Pesto Sauce
raw_recipe.description: This velvety and versatile sauce is also delicious served with chicken or other varieties of fish. For even more flavor, additional pesto could be brushed over the salmon before grilling.

review.reviewBody: This was a very tasty sauce to top grilled salmon. I used sun-dried tomato pesto and sprinkled capers on top. A warning - don't try to make ahead of time and reheat the sauce. It gets thick needs to be diluted with more milk. Very good recipe.
this is great! I made it with sun dried tomato pesto and added sauteed mushrooms. this would be great on pork chops, chicken breast, ect...... Any drier meat.

I liked this recipe. The sauce was very rich, pretty simple. Just remember to keep a close eye on the sauce and continually stir it so that it doesn't bubble, pop or burn. It also holds up well and was just as good when you reheat it the next day.

Modifications I made were: Baking the salmon instead of grilling it (only because I don't own a grill) and I also added a couple pinches of dried dill to the sauce.

Typically, my husband is hard to impress when it comes to my cooking, but he really enjoyed this salmon recipe. I cooked it exactly by the directions, using the very flavorful Buitoni pesto with basil that you can easily find in your local grocery store; however, I tasted the final sauce beforehand (which was tasty), but I felt like it was missing 1 ingredient...garlic. I then chopped up 1 large clove of garlic and added it to the sauce. Extra delicious! I paired it with a garden salad. We will definitely make this again.
This creamy sauce is a welcome change for those who dislike dill. Made this for cedar plank salmon on the BBQ for guests and got rave reviews.

Super simple and delicious. Serve with a side of pasta or some crispy potatoes to dip in the sauce. I double the sauce, never measure the pesto-just go off taste and color, and usually add a little chicken stock to thin it out a bit before serving.

This made totally awesome salmon. I think it would make totally awesome any grilled or baked meat. I doubled the sauce and will use the leftover with baked chicken. I didn't have basil pesto, so used a black olive pesto I had on hand. The cream cheese will make any kind of pesto shine. A keeper for sure!
This sauce was amazing (and so easy). I used white wine in place of the milk, and added parsley and fresh cracked pepper over the top. Served sauce on top of grilled salmon and chicken breast.
I used 3-4 tbsp of pesto and a little sour cream in addition to the cream cheese. The sauce was amazing but the salmon came out dry. I prefer to soak the salmon in something before grilling.

After reading a few reviews decided to try it with a few modifications;the ingredients as is seemed like it would be too bland. I used white wine instead of milk, and sauteed about 1/2 cup sliced mushrooms then added to sauce. Also added some dill. Was tasty but have tried other salmon recipes from this site that I enjoy more.
super easy and delicions. added fresh basil and parmesan, since i didn't have pesto.
Delicious

Absolutely amazing! My husband is a VERY VERRY picky eater. Meat and potatoes kind of guy. Fish has never been in his wheel house when it comes to food. I myself am not a big fish eater. But this recipe has added a completely new meat option for us! So delicious, I can’t wait to make it again.
Made as is and loved it. Picky husband and kids liked it as well. Winner in this family,
This is a good recipe except that the pesto which I used did not make it with me. Next time I will look for another brand.
This is a good recipe except that the pesto which I used did not make it with me. Next time I will look for another brand.
All my kids liked it, so it's a keeper!
I made this on a date it was awesome. The sauce had a great consistency and tasted amazing. I got pesto from whole foods and it was delicious.
Made this for dinner this evening. Hubby didn't say anything and I thought it was okay. I made it as stated, but was out of olive oil, so used a tablespoon of butter.
Amazing!
